maria_cs: Cloverleaf just raised a request to onboard a 13B summarizer for PHI triage. They want a Private deployment (VPC) with HSM + KMS rotation, plus a safety eval focused on PHI detection/redaction. Initial traffic: 5 qps steady, ~30 qps peak. SLA ask: ~50ms p50 for short clinical notes. What are next steps and owners?
jordan_se: Got it — can you share sample sizes and avg doc length? Also are they insisting on quantized weights (8-bit) or full fp16 for highest quality? @oliver_pme FYI on commercial impact.
maria_cs: Asked them for 2k sample docs (they said ~250 tokens avg). Acceptance criteria they provided: FN rate <1% for PHI detection, and redaction precision >99%. They prefer 13B for accuracy; cost is secondary for initial pilot.
anil_sre: Private + customer HSM is doable but infra provisioning for dedicated nodes + HSM attestation tends to be ~3-4 weeks. If they accept Dedicated (hosted reserved) we could be faster but they'd lose on-prem HSM control. @emma_security any mandatory compliance items?
emma_security: We need a signed DPA, SOC2 evidence, and HSM attestation docs. For the safety eval, we should test both "tag-then-redact" and "direct-obfuscation" flows and benchmark PHI leakage. Also require detailed data handling plan (ingest, retention, scrub). I'll put a checklist together.
oliver_pme: Low renewal risk but significant expansion opportunity — let's treat this as upsell path. Recommend creating an enablement runbook for their ops and CS teams so adoption is smooth.
ops_bot: ticket created: CS-2319 Onboard Cloverleaf 13B PHI summarizer -> https://redwood.ticket/CS-2319
jordan_se: I'll start the safety eval draft and test harness. Can someone own infra provisioning for Private deploy? @anil_sre?
anil_sre: Assigning infra owner: anil_sre. I'll open an infra RFC and initial sizing for region us-west-2 with HSM. ETA: preliminary sizing + cost estimate by EOW.
maria_cs: Scheduling kickoff with the customer — Wed 10am PT. I'll push the samples to the secure share and drop the link in this thread. Please add any pre-kickoff checklist items you want covered. Thanks all :thumbsup:
